pages.description: A Minecraft Enderman moves silently through a forest in this printable coloring page, holding a patterned cube on one outstretched palm while taking a long step. Rounded tree canopies overlap behind its tilted head, and spotted mushrooms grow along the rolling ground beneath the character's angular feet.

pages.title: Minecraft Enderman Wandering Aimlessly Near A River Coloring Page
pages.description: A Minecraft Enderman wanders beside a river in this printable coloring page, crossing its long legs as one arm stretches diagonally toward the curving water nearby. Stepped riverbanks wind past small grass tufts, with square crowned trees and pointed mountains forming a simple background behind the walking figure.

pages.title: Minecraft Enderman Looking Around Curiously In A Flower Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: A Minecraft Enderman looks curiously around a flower forest in this printable coloring page, tilting its square head above long arms with broad cubical hands. Large blossoms and tulips border a gridded path, while square tree crowns recede into the dense patch of smaller flowers behind the figure.

pages.title: Minecraft Enderman Waving Happily In A Survival Base Coloring Page
pages.description: A Minecraft Enderman waves happily at a survival base in this printable coloring page, raising a long fingered hand above the roof of a small building. Low fences enclose a crop patch and tiled courtyard, with a furnace beside the house and flat clouds across the sky.

pages.title: Minecraft Enderman Waving Happily On An End Island Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling Minecraft Enderman waves from an End island in this printable coloring page, lifting one angular arm above the bushes and branching plants around its legs. Small dark geometric shapes float beside the platform, whose broad pointed underside forms a solid shadow beneath the open top.

pages.title: Minecraft Enderman Watching Calmly In A Cave Coloring Page
pages.description: A Minecraft Enderman watches calmly inside a cave in this printable coloring page, holding a patterned cube on one upturned palm beneath several pointed hanging formations. Two more cubes float beside the figure, while uneven rock walls and small rising spires frame the long narrow body.

pages.title: Minecraft Enderman Jumping Playfully In A Swamp Coloring Page
pages.description: A Minecraft Enderman jumps playfully over swamp water in this printable coloring page, spreading its long arms while lifting one bent leg above the lily pads. Tall cattails rise beside the curving banks, and rows of rounded trees add repeated shapes behind the airborne figure.

pages.title: Minecraft Enderman Holding An Apple Near A Waterfall Coloring Page
pages.description: A Minecraft Enderman holds an apple beside a waterfall in this printable coloring page, balancing the small fruit on one block shaped hand near its shoulder. A leaf and short stem top the apple, while a two level cascade spills between stepped rocks into a rectangular pool below.

pages.title: Minecraft Enderman Crawling Calmly In A Flower Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: A Minecraft Enderman crawls calmly through a flower forest in this printable coloring page, resting its long forearms on the ground with both knees bent underneath. Tall rounded blossoms and angular leaves surround the low figure, and simple blocky trees form a broad canopy across the background.

pages.title: Minecraft Enderman Floating Calmly In A Lush Cave Coloring Page
pages.description: A Minecraft Enderman floats inside a lush cave in this printable coloring page, with bent legs suspended above small oval shadows on the rocky floor below. Leafy vines hang from the ceiling, and faceted crystals, spotted mushrooms, and thick plants frame the character's long rectangular arms.

pages.title: Minecraft Enderman Relaxing Peacefully In A Dripstone Cave Coloring Page
pages.description: A Minecraft Enderman relaxes in a dripstone cave in this printable coloring page, reclining with its long legs extended and both arms spread across the foreground. Pointed formations hang between tall patterned pillars, while irregular pools and scattered angular stones lead toward a distant passage behind the resting figure.

pages.title: Minecraft Enderman Walking Happily In A Jungle Coloring Page
pages.description: A cheerful Minecraft Enderman walks through a jungle in this printable coloring page, carrying a small cube on one raised palm above its crossed stepping legs. A wide open smile brightens the square face, while hanging vines, palm shaped leaves, rounded bushes, and faceted rocks surround the path.

pages.title: Minecraft Enderman Holding A Flower On An End Island Coloring Page
pages.description: A Minecraft Enderman holds a flower on a small End island in this printable coloring page, with a rounded bloom raised beside its plain square face. Two leaves sprout from the stem, and a pair of outlined geometric crystals floats above the island's cracked, pointed rocky underside.

pages.title: Minecraft Enderman Wandering Curiously In Mountains Coloring Page
pages.description: A Minecraft Enderman wanders through mountains in this printable coloring page, shown in a long stepping pose with thin arms hanging beside its narrow curved torso. Angular snow lines divide the tall peaks, while small blocky trees and rounded bushes fill the slopes beneath broad outlined clouds.

pages.title: Minecraft Enderman Stomping Playfully in a Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: A Minecraft Enderman stomps playfully through a forest in this printable coloring page, lifting one large block shaped foot while its angular fists swing at either side. Spotted mushrooms and small grass tufts dot the ground, and broad tree canopies rise behind the character's tall rectangular body.
